title: VMware & Podman Infrastructure
description: ESXi hosts, VMs, datastores and Podman containers in one place. Managed in Git - edit the JSON in the repo, not in the UI.

panels.title: ESXi CPU
panels.description: Used MHz / total MHz across the selected ESXi hosts.

targets.expr: count((podman_container_state == 2) * on(instance, id) group_left(name, image) podman_container_info{instance=~"$podman_host", name=~"$container"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Containers not running
panels.description: Created / exited / stopped / paused containers. One-shot containers show up here too.

targets.expr: count((podman_container_state != 2) * on(instance, id) group_left(name, image) podman_container_info{instance=~"$podman_host", name=~"$container"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: CPU usage %
panels.description: vSphere cpu.usage.average (reported in 1/100 %). Only powered-on VMs report perf data.

panels.title: Memory usage %
panels.description: vSphere mem.usage.average = active guest memory / configured memory.

panels.title: VM inventory
panels.description: One row per VM. Uptime and CPU are empty for powered-off VMs.

panels.title: CPU ready %
panels.description: Time a vCPU was ready to run but waited for a physical core (20s sample, per vCPU). Above ~5% means the host is overcommitted.

panels.title: Guest disk usage %
panels.description: Needs VMware Tools / open-vm-tools running in the guest.

panels.title: Containers
panels.description: All containers seen by prometheus-podman-exporter on the selected Podman hosts.

targets.expr: podman_container_state * on(instance, id) group_left(name, image) podman_container_info{instance=~"$podman_host", name=~"$container"}
podman_container_mem_usage_bytes * on(instance, id) group_left(name, image) podman_container_info{instance=~"$podman_host", name=~"$container"}

((time() - podman_container_started_seconds) and on(instance, id) (podman_container_state == 2)) * on(instance, id) group_left(name, image) podman_container_info{instance=~"$podman_host", name=~"$container"}
podman_container_mem_usage_bytes * on(instance, id) group_left(name, image) podman_container_info{instance=~"$podman_host", name=~"$container"}
